pattern.description: Vertical slot-machine cycle of option pills after the fixed stem 'One AI tool to': the current pill ('Find in Google Drive') rises and blurs out of the slot while the next ('Find in Slack') rises from below and sharpens into place; neighbours stay faintly visible above and below.
pattern.why_premium: Motion blur plus fade on the travelling pills sells speed without hard edges, and the ghosted neighbours make the list feel like a continuous wheel of integrations rather than discrete slide swaps.

build_hint.gsap: Wheel container: tl.to('.pill-stack', {y:'-=pillPitch', duration:0.25, ease:'power2.inOut'}); per pill in parallel: active -> {opacity:1, filter:'blur(0px)'}, others -> {opacity:0.08, filter:'blur(8px)'}, same duration and ease.
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame: frame - start, fps, config:{damping:200, stiffness:220}}); stack translateY = -(index + p) * pitch; per pill dist = Math.abs(i - (index + p)); opacity = interpolate(dist,[0,1],[1,0.08]); blur = interpolate(dist,[0,1],[0,8]) px.

notes: The third ghost pill below (around y~475, 'Summarize...') is next in the cycle and only slides slightly; not listed separately.
